gen-dafont-disorder-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight keeps its ascenders short and its curves tucked back. Disorder is the raw one, with a tall x-height and glyphs spaced well apart, while the body does the quiet, modern work of staying out of the way.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-mozilla-headline: Rough, loud, and a bit unruly up top. Disorder keeps its joins as thick as its stems, and Mozilla Headline underneath brings big-bodied lowercase that feels friendly and easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads steady and unfussy, with a high midline. Over a full paragraph its counters stay open to the outside, which gives Disorder's laser-etched, constant-width trace something quiet to push against.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-noto-sans-warang-: Chaotic up top, Disorder draws every stroke like a marker at one steady line weight, with large lowercase and loose spacing. Noto Sans Warang Citi settles words into solid blocks.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-preahvihear: Jumpy, loose, and outlined in one steady line. Disorder sets its tall lowercase well apart, while Preahvihear answers with an open, oyster-like mouth and a lofty x-height that lets the two share a page comfortably.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-sarpanch: Raw strokes, no contrast, nothing softened. Disorder runs its lines from stem to terminal untouched, and Sarpanch below keeps a compact gap between x-height and ascenders, with an open e that feels approachable.
